The '''All-Russian Mathematical Portal''' (better known as '''Math-Net.Ru''') is a [[web portal]] that provides extensive access to all aspects of [[Russian mathematics]], including journals, organizations, conferences, articles, videos, libraries, software, and people.<ref>{{citation
 | last1 = Zhizhchenko | first1 = Aleksei B.
 | last2 = Izaak | first2 = Aleksandr D.
 | doi = 10.1070/RM2007v062n05ABEH004455
 | journal = Russian Mathematical Surveys
 | page = 943
 | title = The information system math-net.ru. Application of contemporary technologies in the scientific work of mathematicians
 | volume = 62
 | issue = 5
 | year = 2008| s2cid = 250789652
 }}.</ref><ref>{{citation
 | last1 = Zhizhchenko | first1 = Aleksei B.
 | last2 = Izaak | first2 = Aleksandr D.
 | doi = 10.1070/RM2009v064n04ABEH004638
 | journal = Russian Mathematical Surveys
 | page = 775
 | title = The information system math-net.ru. Current state and prospects. The impact factors of Russian mathematics journals
 | volume = 64
 | issue = 4
 | year = 2009| bibcode = 2009RuMaS..64..775Z
 | s2cid = 250755474
 }}.</ref> The portal is a joint project of the [[Steklov Mathematical Institute]] and the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. Access to information in the portal is generally free, except for the full-text sources of certain publications which have elected to make their content available on a fee basis.<ref name=ARMP>{{cite web
 | title = About this project
 | publisher = All-Russian Mathematical Portal
 | url = http://www.mathnet.ru/about.phtml?option_lang=eng
 | accessdate = 7 Oct 2012}}</ref>

The website can be read in either Russian or English. As a standard default, it renders on-screen mathematics using [[MathJax]].<ref name=ARMP/>
